hypothesis: Predicting evidence uniquely lost when omitting a view selects a safer omission than predicting the number of objects a view detects, at identical four-view cost.
sample: Exactly first128 candidate12 fitting and first64 head-held-out train images, same order. First filename-prefix scene sets must be disjoint. Detector already saw both splits; not independent generalization.
budget: Existing raw predictions only, no detector forwards, no official evaluation. Two small32-hidden-unit MLPs, CPU,80 epochs, batch128, Adam lr0.003, no scheduler or weight decay. Seed0 first; only if every seed0 gate passes repeat fixed seeds1/2.
prediction_inputs: Only native unfiltered fullimage raw predictions and five known view windows, before local views are available. Perwindow geometry, score/size/class counts, boundary contacts and fullimage/global-window context. No local-view predictions, object labels, ignores or filenames in the model input.

targets.ordinary_coverage: For each local view, sum its standalone all-GT maximum match capacity at native confidence0.05 and IoU0.5/0.75
targets.marginal_loss: For each omission, sum over IoU0.5/0.75 of max(number full-pool-supported GT losing support, all-GT maximum matching capacity loss)

matching: Heads share input, architecture, seed initialization, batch order, loss and training rows. For each head separately normalize log1p target using fitting-only mean/std, with floor1e-3. Standardize inputs using fitting-only mean/std floor1e-3 and clip to[-6,6]. Mean squared regression loss, final epoch80 only.
inference: For every image choose the local view with lowest predicted target, tie earliest view index. Always omit exactly one local view and retain global+three locals: count savings fixed20%. No score threshold or selective abstention tuned on holdout.
controls: Full5, global-density-one at confidence0.25 from candidate25, fixed-one, and matched ordinary_coverage head. Candidate25 empty and GT-assisted oracle remain descriptive references.
evaluation: Before metric inspection, produce all perimage choices from global predictions only. Then evaluate native pool support loss by group at IoU0.5/0.75 and all-GT matching loss. These are coverage proxies, not actual AP, detector recall or runtime.
pass_action: Register a bounded prediction-only fusion/calibration replay and official accuracy/cost audit. The frozen five-view calibrator's missing-view distribution must be audited, not assumed compatible. No full detector training.
fail_action: Stop this fixed global-box-feature marginal-view regressor. Do not change epochs, learning rate, target weights, omission count, threshold or seed to rescue it.
prior_art: AutoFocus already predicts where high-resolution processing is useful; selective regions, learned crop values and avoiding redundant processing have substantial prior art. A narrower marginal-evidence objective must demonstrate independent benefit and still requires nearest-method review before novelty claims.
limits: Tiny128/64 scene split, repeated study data, noisy proxy labels, inherited diagnostic ignore filtering for label/evaluation pools, no AP/latency proof. Prediction inputs themselves must remain unfiltered and annotation-free.
